description: the Daughter of Perun, a young goddess of thunder, one strong idea: the great thunder sign of Perun behind her, a huge glowing golden wheel with six curved petals inside a ring, like a giant sun-shield of light, with a few bright white lightning bolts crackling around its rim, close to the body; shining armour of polished gold with a lightning mark on the chest, a long deep crimson cape, bareheaded, holding a big bow of golden oak crackling with white lightning, her face lit by the golden glow, a palette of only gold, deep crimson and white lightning; young woman, clearly a woman with a feminine figure and a slim waist, light skin, long fair blond hair in a thick braid over her shoulder, a beautiful sharp young face with full lips, her face clearly visible, well lit and well drawn, with distinct eyes with dark pupils, eyebrows, nose and mouth, not in shadow; standing tall in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, clean readable pixel art with bold simple shapes, strong contrast and a few large details, no clutter, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same design as this man, drawn as a woman: the same outfit, colours, everything around the figure and pose, but clearly a woman, with a slim feminine figure, a narrow waist and armour shaped for a woman; she keeps her own face, skin and hair as described, not his
